correctness.rationale: For n>=5 the intrinsic triangle or square incidences distinguish clique edges from cycle edges, forcing Aut(C_n square K_m)=D_n x S_m. Fixing (0,0) gives precisely two orbit cells at each cyclic distance. By induction on the counting update, each round-t colour determines rooted walk numbers for lengths at most t. Distinct root distances separate profiles. At shared distance k>=2, A_k has one shortest root walk, or two at an even antipode, while B_{k-1} has k; these differ for all permitted k. At shared distance one, A_1 has zero two-walks and B_0 has m-2, unless m=2, when three-walks are 6 and 7. Hence all orbit profiles split by D=floor(n/2) for n>=6, and by D for n=5,m>=3; n=5,m=2 needs three. The regular graph wavefront leaves A_D and B_D identical at round D-1, proving sharpness. At n=5,m=2 the two distance-one orbits remain identical through round two. Direct and quotient verification checks reproduce the exact finite formula, but the infinite statement rests on this proof.

Primary full text in Kiefer–McKay (2020, arXiv:2005.10182) concerns worst-case iteration numbers and long-refinement constructions, not a formula for one-marked C_n square K_m. The public semantic-index matches directly involving C_n square K_m compute Vietoris–Rips or neighborhood-complex invariants, not rooted colour refinement. Related exact statements on rooted powers of cycles use altered within-cycle adjacency, while those on rooted products of complete graphs lack a genuinely noncomplete cycle factor. value.rationale: The family C_n square K_m is an infinite, structurally natural two-parameter class comprising ordinary prisms and clique-fibre cylinders. Root-stabilizer recovery is a meaningful symmetry-reconstruction question for counting refinement, and exact stopping depth is a natural algorithmic invariant. The theorem gives both complete orbit types/class sizes and a sharp exact round formula with a nontrivial pentagonal-prism exception. A walk-count proof explains why refinement completes at cyclic radius, one round before the root eccentricity for n>=6. This is not a reparameterization of the complete-factor Hamming product or powers of cycles.
